purpose: Teach: ルノー/葛飾/ジャッキー/ポーカー/ドラクエ/マスターズ/ワンセグ/スペースシャトル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、ルノー乗ってたな
lines.en: Riku, your family has a Renault, right?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a teasing lilt. Quick delivery, eyes bright. Testing ground for the volley ahead. Slight smirk in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、葛飾の漫画好きだったな、桜
lines.en: You liked manga from Katsushika, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Casual counter-volley, lobbing it back. Warm and even. Not defensive — just matching her energy, remembering something equally embarrassing about her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ジャッキーチェンの映画真似してたな
lines.en: Riku, you used to copy Jackie Chan movies.
lines.style: Sharper this time, eyes narrowing with satisfaction. Faster clip. The 'gotcha' moment — she's found something good. Slight laugh threaded through.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家でポーカーやってたな、桜
lines.en: You played poker at your house, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quick retaliation, grin evident in his voice. Matching her pace now, not backing down. Lean-in energy — they're both enjoying this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ドラクエ全シリーズやってるだろ
lines.en: Riku, you're playing through every Dragon Quest game.
lines.style: Delighted accusation, picking up momentum. Light and certain. She's landed on something she knows for sure — voiced with the warmth of inside knowledge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゴルフでマスターズ目指してたな、桜
lines.en: You were aiming for the Masters in golf, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Softer shot this time, almost gentle. Still in the game but with less bite — remembering something sincere underneath the teasing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ワンセグで授業中見てたろ
lines.en: Riku, you watched One-seg during class.
lines.style: Drawn-out satisfaction, building the accusation slowly. Slight incredulous laugh. She's surprised herself by remembering this one — it lands with delight.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でスペースシャトル習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about space shuttles in social studies, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Close, conspiratorial, almost to himself. Softer than the volleys before — intimate memory surfaces. Slight smile in his voice, a little vulnerable.
